title: Port stale-page first-clock timestamp and reset
scope: Complete pageStale, markPageStale and resetPageStale over a fallible owned UTC timestamp supplier. Preserve first-call clock sampling, no replacement and reset; platform Date-to-UTC conversion remains an explicit host adapter.
acceptance: Full original source traces compare repeated marks, resets, clock-call counts, errors and all resulting timestamps.
No page mutation on failed sampling; full existing classifier and native gates remain required.
open_items: Actual platform clock and UTC ISO formatting adapter, browser preload listener and registry error normalization remain separate.
Clock sampling is synchronous and non-reentrant; executable JS Date constructor reentrancy is outside this boundary.
